notes.text: Pinchas explicitly reports in the name of Elazar son of Rabbi Menachem. His report concerns David’s music at midnight.
Ilai bar Menachem names a different setting, on Proverbs 15:29. Pair as a name comparison rather than identical attribution.
The reciprocal heading gives the Leviticus Rabbah comparison and keeps the spelling question open.
The Abbahu conversation remains an expressly qualified nonfinding. Compared the named Pinchas attribution and reciprocal Ilai passage. Neither contains this conversation.
The proposed spelling correction remains conjectural. One named source gives Elazar bar Menachem and the other Ilai bar Menachem, in different sayings.
